content.user_title: Migrate AngularJS Apps to Modern Angular
content.value_statement: Legacy AngularJS applications are hard to maintain and upgrade. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a structured migration guide for hybrid Angular upgrades.
actual_capabilities: Explains big bang, incremental, and vertical slice migration strategies.
Shows how to bootstrap AngularJS and Angular together with UpgradeModule.
Maps AngularJS controllers and directives to Angular components.
Shows service migration from $http to Angular HttpClient.
Covers dependency injection, routing, and forms migration patterns.
Provides a phased migration timeline and common pitfalls.
limitations: It is a guidance document and does not run migrations automatically.
It does not inspect a project unless the agent reads your repository files.
Examples use generic user service patterns, not project-specific architecture.
It references extra resources that are not present in this single-file package.

use_cases.title: Plan a Legacy Upgrade
use_cases.description: Create a phased plan for moving an AngularJS application to Angular without a full rewrite.

use_cases.title: Convert Application Patterns
use_cases.description: Translate AngularJS controllers, directives, services, routes, and forms into Angular equivalents.

use_cases.title: Review Hybrid Architecture
use_cases.description: Check whether an ngUpgrade setup supports incremental delivery and clear cleanup phases.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Migration Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the angular-migration skill to compare migration strategies for my AngularJS app. Recommend one path and explain the tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Hybrid Bootstrap
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the angular-migration skill to outline a hybrid AngularJS and Angular bootstrap plan for this repository.

prompt_templates.title: Convert a Feature Slice
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the angular-migration skill to convert this AngularJS feature into Angular components, services, routing, and forms.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Migration Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the angular-migration skill to audit this project for migration blockers, hybrid risks, test gaps, and cleanup steps.

output_examples.input: Plan an AngularJS to Angular migration for a large product dashboard.
output: Recommended approach: incremental hybrid migration with ngUpgrade.
Start with services and shared utilities before moving high-traffic features.
Track cleanup work for AngularJS modules, routes, and build configuration.

output_examples.input: Convert an AngularJS user card directive to Angular.
output: The directive becomes an Angular component with input properties and output events.
The template moves from isolate scope bindings to Angular property and event binding.
Parent templates must update from directive syntax to the new component selector.

output_examples.input: Review our migration risks before starting feature work.
output: Primary risks include routing overlap, change detection differences, and insufficient test coverage.
Mitigate by migrating shared services first and validating each feature slice before release.

best_practices: Migrate shared services and utilities before UI-heavy features.
Keep AngularJS and Angular integration boundaries explicit during hybrid mode.
Test each migrated feature before removing legacy AngularJS code.
anti_patterns: Starting with complex UI screens before stabilizing shared services.
Mixing AngularJS and Angular patterns inside the same component boundary.
Removing ngUpgrade or AngularJS modules before all dependent routes are migrated.

faq.question: Does this skill migrate code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides migration guidance, examples, and review structure for an AI coding agent.

faq.question: Can it help with large AngularJS applications?
faq.answer: Yes. It focuses on incremental hybrid migration, which is often safer for large applications.

faq.question: Does it cover ngUpgrade?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes hybrid bootstrap guidance and dependency sharing between AngularJS and Angular.

faq.question: Does it include routing migration?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows AngularJS route examples and equivalent Angular Router configuration patterns.

faq.question: Does it handle forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares AngularJS forms with Angular template-driven and reactive form approaches.

faq.question: Should I use a full rewrite instead?
faq.answer: Use a full rewrite only for small applications or isolated projects with low delivery risk.
